input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no minimum purchase, minimum spend, take-or-pay or shortfall obligation on AP. The economics are a pure revenue share on actual auction activity (§5, p0023: "The Parties agree to share any revenue generated as a result of this Agreement... as set forth and detailed in each applicable Exhibit"), so AP pays nothing absent usage; the only Customer payment obligation is applicable taxes. Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP may offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, so there are no volume caps or channel restrictions on AP. The two "minimum" hits are benign: p0014 defines Winning Bid Price by reference to AP's own agreed floor price (a protection for us), and p0062 is a disclaimer that no minimum revenue is guaranteed (not a commitment by AP). The Initial Term lock-in in §4(a) restricts termination but does not create any purchase or volume commitment, so it falls outside this rule. Commercial Exhibits are not exposed in this document; if an Exhibit introduces a minimum spend or volume commitment, we would revisit under the fallback (commitment limited to the current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up).
